description: ‘I’ agreed to be suitable for use in an actual CLA calculation to produce a catch limit
‘C’ used in the RMP/SLA  trial conditioning as an absolute estimate of abundance
‘Cmin’ used in the RMP/SLA trial conditioning a minimum estimate of abundance
‘CP’ provisional estimate suitable for use in conditioning but further analysis needs to be considered before use in an actual CLA or SLA calculation
‘T' used in RMP / SLA trials but further analysis needs to be considered before use in an actual CLA or SLA calculation.
‘S’ agreed to be suitable for use with an SLA to produce strike limits
‘E’ suitable for conditioning Evaluation and Robustness Trials, and for Implementation Reviews.

‘R’ suitable for conditioning Robustness Trials or Suitable for conditioning some Evaluation or Robustness Trials, or Implementation Reviews, where the value is used as a minimum estimate of abundance
